description_en: Performs a paging query for the credit consumption of the caller account within a specified time range, where each result corresponds to a metering record. You can query a single workspace or all workspaces under the account, excluding storage items that do not consume credits. By default, the results are in descending order of request time, but sorting by credit amount is supported. Metering records are written asynchronously, so recent usage may not be displayed. To view time trends, invoke `GetContextDatabaseCreditUsageSummary`
description_zh: 分页查询调用方账号在指定时间区间内的 Credit 消耗，一条结果对应一条计量记录。可查询单个 Workspace 或账号下全部 Workspace，但不包含不消耗 Credit 的存储项。默认按请求时间倒序，可改按 Credit 排序。计量记录异步写入，近期用量可能尚未显示。查看时间趋势可调用 `GetContextDatabaseCreditUsageSummary`
name: ListContextDatabaseCreditUsageRecords

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range, inclusive. Use the ISO 8601 time format, such as `2026-09-15T00:00:00Z` (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的开始时间，包含该时刻。使用 ISO 8601 时间格式，例如 `2026-09-15T00:00:00Z`（UTC）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range, exclusive. It must be later than StartTime. Use the ISO 8601 time format, such as `2026-10-15T00:00:00Z` (UTC). The maximum length of the query range is 31 days. If the limit is exceeded, InvalidParameter is returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的结束时间，不包含该时刻，必须晚于 `StartTime`。使用 ISO 8601 时间格式，例如 `2026-10-15T00:00:00Z`（UTC）。 查询区间最长 31 天，超限返回 `InvalidParameter`
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to query. If specified, only the data of this workspace under the caller account is queried, and locked workspaces can also be queried. If omitted, all workspaces under the caller account are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的 Workspace ID。指定时只查询调用方账号下该 Workspace 的数据，已锁定的 Workspace 也可查询；省略时查询调用方账号下的全部 Workspace
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The member ID used to filter records. If specified, WorkspaceId must also be provided. Otherwise, InvalidParameter is returned. A member ID is unique only within the workspace to which it belongs. This parameter only filters data and does not change the caller identity. Records without a member ID are not matched
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选记录的成员 ID。指定时必须同时传入 `WorkspaceId`，否则返回 `InvalidParameter`。成员 ID 只在所属 Workspace 内唯一。此参数只筛选数据，不改变调用身份；没有成员 ID 的记录不会命中
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.help_en: The billing item used to filter records. Valid values: KnowledgeBaseRead (knowledge base read), MemoryRead (memory base read), MemoryWrite (memory base write), KnowledgeBaseWriteToken (knowledge base write token), and ContextGrowth (context growth). If omitted, all billing items that consume credits are included. Storage items or unlisted values return InvalidParameter
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选记录的计费项。支持 KnowledgeBaseRead（知识库读取）、MemoryRead（记忆库读取）、MemoryWrite（记忆库写入）、KnowledgeBaseWriteToken（知识库写入 Token）、ContextGrowth（上下文演进）。省略时包含全部消耗 Credit 的计费项；存储项或未列出的值会返回 `InvalidParameter`
parameters.name: item

parameters.help_en: The context growth sub-item used to filter records. Valid values: KnowledgeOrganization (knowledge organization), MemoryPromotion (memory promotion), KnowledgeReview (knowledge review), KnowledgeEvolution (knowledge evolution), and MemoryEvolution (memory evolution). The values are case-sensitive. If only SubItem is provided, the billing item is automatically restricted to ContextGrowth. If other Item values are provided simultaneously or the sub-item is not in the list, InvalidParameter is returned
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选记录的上下文演进子项。支持 KnowledgeOrganization（知识整理）、MemoryPromotion（记忆晋升）、KnowledgeReview（知识评审）、KnowledgeEvolution（知识演进）和 MemoryEvolution（记忆演进），区分大小写。只传 `SubItem` 时，计费项自动限定为 `ContextGrowth`；若同时传入其他 `Item` 或子项不在列表中，则返回 `InvalidParameter`
parameters.name: sub_item

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the records. Only credits is supported. If omitted, the records are sorted in descending order of request time. Specifying a sort field does not change the total number of filtered records
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，仅支持 `credits`。省略时按请求时间倒序排列。指定排序字段不会改变筛选后的记录总数
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: asc (ascending order) and desc (descending order). The values are case-insensitive. If SortBy is specified, the default value is desc. If only SortOrder is provided, InvalidParameter is returned. When sorting by credit, unpriced records are always placed at the end, and records with the same amount are sorted in descending order of request time
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向：`asc` 为升序，`desc` 为降序，不区分大小写。指定 `SortBy` 时默认 `desc`；只传 `SortOrder` 返回 `InvalidParameter`。按 Credit 排序时，未定价的记录始终排在最后，金额相同的记录按请求时间倒序排列
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 50. The pagination offset, calculated as (Page - 1) × PageSize, must not exceed 10,000
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的记录数，取值范围为 1～200，默认值为 50。 分页偏移量 `(Page - 1) × PageSize` 不得超过 10,000
parameters.name: page_size

Dimension.description_en: The query dimension. Valid values: Workspace (a single workspace) and Account (all workspaces under the caller account)
Dimension.description_zh: 查询维度：`Workspace` 表示单个 Workspace；`Account` 表示调用方账号下全部 Workspace

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query range passed in the request, exclusive
EndTime.description_zh: 请求中传入的查询区间结束时间，不包含该时刻

Page.description_en: The actual page number used for this query
Page.description_zh: 本次查询实际使用的页码

PageSize.description_en: The actual page size used for this query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询实际使用的每页条数

Records.description_en: The metering records on the current page. If SortBy is not specified, the records are sorted in descending order of request time
Records.description_zh: 当前页的计量记录。未指定 `SortBy` 时按请求时间倒序排列

Credits.description_en: The credit consumption of this record. It is returned as a decimal string with up to 6 decimal places, where 1 credit equals 1 CNY. The amount is recorded at the time of metering and does not change with subsequent price adjustments. If unpriced, null is returned, which does not indicate zero consumption
Credits.description_zh: 本条记录的 Credit 消耗。以十进制字符串返回，最多 6 位小数；1 Credit = 1 元人民币。 金额在计量时记录，不随后续调价变化；未定价时为 `null`，不表示零消耗

Item.description_en: The billing item of this record. Valid values: KnowledgeBaseRead (knowledge base read), MemoryRead (memory base read), MemoryWrite (memory base write), KnowledgeBaseWriteToken (knowledge base write token), and ContextGrowth (context growth)
Item.description_zh: 本条记录的计费项：KnowledgeBaseRead（知识库读取）、MemoryRead（记忆库读取）、MemoryWrite（记忆库写入）、KnowledgeBaseWriteToken（知识库写入 Token）、ContextGrowth（上下文演进）

MemberId.description_en: The member ID that generated this record. Historical or system records may not have a member ID, in which case null is returned
MemberId.description_zh: 产生本条记录的成员 ID。历史或系统记录可能没有成员 ID，此时返回 `null`

Quantity.description_en: The usage of this record. The unit is specified by the Unit field in the same record
Quantity.description_zh: 本条记录的用量，单位由同一条记录的 `Unit` 指定

RequestTime.description_en: The request time when this metering record was generated, in ISO 8601 UTC time format ending with `Z`
RequestTime.description_zh: 产生本条计量记录的请求时间，使用以 `Z` 结尾的 ISO 8601 UTC 时间格式

SubItem.description_en: The context growth sub-item. Recognized values include KnowledgeOrganization (knowledge organization), MemoryPromotion (memory promotion), KnowledgeReview (knowledge review), KnowledgeEvolution (knowledge evolution), and MemoryEvolution (memory evolution). For other billing items, missing sub-items, or unrecognized sub-items, null is returned
SubItem.description_zh: 上下文演进子项。已识别的取值包括 KnowledgeOrganization（知识整理）、MemoryPromotion（记忆晋升）、KnowledgeReview（知识评审）、KnowledgeEvolution（知识演进）和 MemoryEvolution（记忆演进）。其他计费项、缺少子项或未识别的子项返回 `null`

Unit.description_en: The metering unit. Valid values: Count (number of times), Token (number of tokens), and MicroCredit (one millionth of a credit)
Unit.description_zh: 计量单位：`Count` 表示次数，`Token` 表示词元数，`MicroCredit` 表示百万分之一 Credit

WorkspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which this record belongs. Even if queried by account, each record still indicates the workspace it belongs to
WorkspaceId.description_zh: 本条记录所属的 Workspace ID。即使按账号查询，每条记录仍标明所属 Workspace

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the OpenAPI request, which is used to troubleshoot call issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次 OpenAPI 请求的 ID，用于定位调用问题

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query range passed in the request, inclusive
StartTime.description_zh: 请求中传入的查询区间开始时间，包含该时刻

Total.description_en: The total number of metering records that meet the filter conditions, which is not affected by pagination
Total.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的计量记录总数，不受分页影响

WorkspaceId.description_en: The ID of the queried workspace. This parameter has a value only when Dimension is Workspace. It is empty for the account dimension
WorkspaceId.description_zh: 查询的 Workspace ID。仅在 `Dimension` 为 `Workspace` 时有值；账号维度下为空
